profile.text: Bryophyta, real name Enis Visser, is from Siesta. Together with his family, he runs a restaurant-and-bar called the 'White Volcano' on Fashion Street, a tourist hotspot in Siesta. Following the volcanic eruption, he was advised to seek treatment at Rhodes Island as per Ceylon's medical advice, and has now joined Logistics in assisting with daily affairs.
